## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? Link the issue it closes, if any. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Refactor without behaviour change (`refactor`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Tooling / CI (`chore`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `yarn check` passes (lint, types, unit tests)
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by unit tests
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in `docs/`
- [ ] Behaviour is verified in `example/` on a device or simulator
- [ ] Commits follow the [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en) format
